item.guildmark.wagon_bill.hint: Use it at its yard to roll the wagon out, or anywhere else to call it home to the nearest Store's yard.
item.guildmark.wagon_bill.hint2: Calling it home is free on the wagon's first day and costs a little after. Sneak to send it home from beside it.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.left: You went on without your wagon: it waits where it stood, and its Bill calls it home.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.held_up: It waits; come back to the horse to lead it round.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.lost: The way back to the wagon is too long to follow: it waits. Come back to the horse to lead it on.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.let_go: You let go of the lead. The wagon waits here.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.led: You take the lead. Use the horse's head again to let go.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.not_yours_: That wagon isn't yours to lead.
That wagon belongs to somebody else.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.off: Carrier's wagons are switched off (setting: Carrier's Wagon).
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.busy: Your wagon is being brought round; wait a moment.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.in_yard: Your wagon is in its yard: use its Bill here to roll it out.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.no_horse: It has no horse in its shafts. Buy one at your Store's desk.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.mounted: Get down first to take the lead.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.bill_gone: The wagon this Bill was for is gone.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.coming: Your wagon is on its way to the yard at %1$s: there in %2$s.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.waits_yard: Your wagon waits in the yard at %1$s (%2$s). Use the Bill there to roll it out.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.bill_led: Your wagon is right behind you. Sneak and use the Bill to send it home all the same.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.bill_here: Your wagon is right here. Sneak and use the Bill to send it home all the same.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.off_yard: Carrier's wagons are switched off (setting: Carrier's Wagon), so it stays in the yard.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.no_horse_y: Your wagon has no horse yet. Buy one at the Store's desk to roll it out.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.no_yard: There is no yard to send it to, so it is brought to you here.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.sent: Your wagon is sent home to the yard at %s. It will be there in the morning.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.sent_now: Your wagon is brought to the yard at %s.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.fee_free: No fee: it is the wagon's first day.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.fee_short: The carter's fee is %s Marks and you couldn't pay it; they brought it all the same.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.bought: You bought a Wagon Bill for %s Marks. Your wagon waits in the Store's yard; buy it a horse to roll it out.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.horse_here: %1$s is yours for %2$s Marks, and stands by your wagon in this yard.
message.guildmark.trade.wagon.horse_sent: %1$s is yours for %2$s Marks, and is taken to your wagon.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.why.not_: Only the Store's owner can buy here.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.why.fail: That couldn't be done just now.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.why.off: Carrier's wagons are switched off (setting: Carrier's Wagon).
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.why.fact: Wagon Bills are sold to Factors and above.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.why.here: Your wagon is in this yard already.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.why.comi: Your wagon is on its way to this yard already.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.offer: A Wagon Bill buys a carrier's wagon of %s slots, kept in this yard. Lead it by its horse's head and it follows the way you walk.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.state.co: Your wagon is on its way to the yard at %1$s: there in %2$s.
Your wagon is on its way to a yard: there in %s.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.state.he: Your wagon stands in this yard.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.state.ya: Your wagon stands in the yard at %s.
Your wagon stands in a yard.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.state.pa: Your wagon waits on the road at %1$s, %2$s, %3$s.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.state.aw: Your wagon waits on a road in another land.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.state.le: Your wagon is on the road behind you.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.no_horse: It has no horse yet: buy one to roll it out.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.hold: Its hold: %1$s of %2$s slots in use.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.copy: A new copy of the Bill
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.tip.bill: The wagon waits in this yard. Use the Bill here to roll it out, and anywhere else to call it home.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.tip.hors: A draught horse for its shafts, taken to the wagon wherever it stands.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.tip.reca: It is brought to this yard by the next morning. Free on its first day, %s after.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.tip.copy: Every copy of your Bill calls the same wagon.
gui.guildmark.trade.store.wagon.note: The Bill calls the wagon home from anywhere, to the nearest of your Stores' yards or a town's wagon stand. Lead it by its horse's head; it waits wherever you leave it.
